scope: Register the 20 originally missing event images one at a time after root selects the actual generated PNG. Never mass-approve the 151-item backlog.

runtime.preferredLookup: ImageRouting.candidates uses routing.assets[imageId], otherwise the existing image_ids fileName. PixelAssetLoader then reads assets/images/<path>.
runtime.existingCatalog: All 20 event image IDs already exist; do not append duplicate IDs or change event story imageId. Their catalog usage is pov, not scene.
runtime.newPortraitMaster: The missing source itself may be a portrait; no landscape original is fabricated and no image is stretched to satisfy a validator.

metadataContract.widthAndHeight: Required measured positive integers, each <=4096, exactly matching the actual PNG.
metadataContract.aspectRule: abs(width*16-height*9)*100 < height*9 (strictly less than 1% relative deviation from 9:16).
metadataContract.membership: Must be a current event preferred imageId/povImageId and explicitly routed.
metadataContract.genericProtection: requiredImageIds and periodPortraits/statScenes/periodScenes/endingScenes may not opt in; all marker-free legacy sources retain positive 4:3.

steps: Read each current full event and compare its hash with the individual generation brief before generation or review.
Preserve generation output path, exact prompt, rejected outputs and selected PNG SHA in the root production manifest. Copy only the selected valid PNG to its existing catalog filename.

Read PNG dimensions/CRC; add sourceFormat and exact measured width/height to that existing catalog item, and add the matching routing entry. The helper build/audit/register_missing_portrait_sources.py accepts explicitly selected event IDs only and writes catalog/routing only.
Run validate_content.py and validate_images.py and Python regression tests. Run the root-owned JVM integrity suite with the explicit-format contract; do not weaken original SHA checks.

Inspect every selected original for current event meaning, hands/objects/text and forbidden future outcomes, then inspect actual native event display including portrait crop and UI overlay. Record actual evidence and truthful AI reviewer.

Only after the individual native review passes, append an approved group with the exact imageId/path/SHA/eventIds/current eventSourceHashes and separate semantic/visual/crop evidence. Preserve prior review history. Update that event row classificationStatus/approvedGroupId/reviewer fields only; never claim the original missing snapshot was already present.
Run basic coverage and --acceptance; remaining events stay pending and strict failure is expected until all required items are actually complete.
approvalRecordRequiredFields: resolvedIssueEvidence per event if existingArtVerdict requires revision
classificationCaution: validate_followup_image_coverage.INPUT_FIELDS are historical baseline inputs; preserve title/text/preferredImageId/resolvedAssetPath/preferredFileExists and other baseline fields unless the baseline snapshot is deliberately versioned. Current file existence belongs in new evidence, not by rewriting old preferredFileExists=NO.

verificationAtThisSnapshot.jvm: Not run by this agent; root owns Gradle

strictAcceptance.reason: Individual native review and art acceptance intentionally not changed by registration.
